title: Core Book Chapter 12 — Monster Table
audience: Core Book Author (Valtay); player-facing Core Rulebook
changelog: v0.2: Caleb rulings 2026-10-05 — X-059 Krakaren Neighborhood READY; X-060 pupa dual-burst READY; X-063 Acid Impaler moved to F3 CANON-RUMOR READY; X-080 Rot Stickers F1-only, F2 slot = HOUSE Fizz Grub. Closers X-081..X-084 / M-762..M-765.
scope_note: Starts from 10 playable Floor 1 Encounter Bot stubs (exact SRD ids), then Floor 1–2 canon-floor tables. Skip unverified-only roster rows (Thorn Cadaver, Hobgoblin maze, dingo-control spell). NPCs (Maestro, Mexx-55, Team Li Na, Mind Horror guides, Mongo pet prize) omitted from this combat table.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot Floor 1 mapping (enc-d01-08 / budget z02).
entries.flavor: Ankle specialists from the HVAC. They hiss like the ducts are laughing at you.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Poisonous bite flavor only if you also run the canon Rat; otherwise SRD Giant Rat as written.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping (enc-d01-11 / budget z05).
entries.flavor: Department-store smiles glued to wrong bones. The polo shirts are a war crime.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Vulnerable to bludgeoning as Skeleton. Bows and staff badges, not rusted swords.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping (enc-d01-02 / budget z07).
entries.flavor: Clipboard, EXIT-sign hat, customer-service voice. The ambush is the only honest part of the job.
entries.reskin_tweaks: None required beyond nameplate.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping (enc-d01-02 / budget z07).
entries.flavor: Same smile, worse benefits. Dies for tips the veteran will steal.
entries.reskin_tweaks: None.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping (enc-d01-03 / budget z08).
entries.flavor: Empty pit-bull costume with opinions. Foam outside, felony inside.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Describe padded foam shell; stats remain Animated Armor.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping (enc-d01-03 / budget z08).
entries.flavor: An ID badge that files itself in your arteries. HR finally found a use for compliance.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Cosmetic: plastic badge on a razor lanyard.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping (wandering / Days 2–4).
entries.flavor: Ceiling girlfriend energy. Attaches, drinks, reviews your hemoglobin.
entries.reskin_tweaks: None beyond nameplate. Cannot enter saferooms.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping (enc-d04-03 / enc-d05-03 / budget z10).
entries.flavor: Flashlight, hush tone, zero mercy. Shows you to your seats and then to your grave.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Flashlights instead of shortswords if you want the bit; damage can stay piercing.

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping Variant A (enc-d05-03 / budget z10). House stage boss.
entries.flavor: Oversized academic who flunks Crawlers with a podium. The group-photo attack is telegraphed and still somehow your fault.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Greatclub as podium/flagpole. One telegraphed AoE "class photo" slam (house telegraph; same damage budget as Ogre greatclub).

entries.mapping_note: Exact Encounter Bot mapping Variant B for level-1 dash parties (enc-d05-03).
entries.flavor: Same tenure, smaller grant. Still wants you off the stage.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Use instead of Ogre Dean when the party is still level 1.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (same SRD family as Vent Rat; this is the floor-wide janitor).
entries.flavor: Janitors with teeth. They eat the dead because nobody else applied for the job.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Add poison on bite (DC 10 Con, 1d4 poison) to match poisonous-bite lore; pack tactics as SRD.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: bread-loaf cockroach swarm ≈ insect swarm.
entries.flavor: Cockroaches the size of lunch meat with union density. Step on one, interview the rest.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Reskin visuals to cockroaches; keep swarm resistances and bite.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: cat-sized charging cockroach ≈ giant centipede.
entries.flavor: The middle manager of the nest. Faster, meaner, still a bug.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Poison bite as centipede; describe as oversized cockroach.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping. Signature: vomit Scatterers; choke the mouth to stop the flow.
entries.flavor: Garbage troll with a recycling policy written in bile. One trick, one weakness, infinite trash.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Once per round while mouth free: vomit 1 Scatterer swarm (or 1d4 individual cockroach tokens). Blocking/stuffing the mouth stops spawns. Door seals the arena.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (same SRD as Exit Greeter; this is the clan version).
entries.flavor: Pineapple clubs and collective revenge. Kill one, interview the whole HOA.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Clubs over scimitars if you want the pineapple bit; damage stays bludgeoning.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping + operator trait.
entries.flavor: Weird hat, worse OSHA record. If the Murder Dozer is rolling, this is who put the key in.
entries.reskin_tweaks: While piloting the Murder Dozer, use the Dozer entry instead. On foot: Goblin Warrior with thieves' tools flavor.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping; ranged explosives.
entries.flavor: Percussion section for people who hate buildings. Sparking bombs, zero encore.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Replace shortbow with thrown Goblin Dynamite / alchemist's fire (same attack bonus). Explosives inert in saferooms.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: clan caster. Priest is a judgment call for a focused-blast shaman.
entries.flavor: Clan magic with a blast radius and a god nobody invited. Loud faith, louder boom.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Swap radiant spells for fire/force blasts of equal level slots; keep CR 2 action economy. Drop if too hot for early F1 and use Goblin Warrior + 2× leveled slots instead.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: spiked steam juggernaut treated as a CR 2 construct chassis.
entries.flavor: Steam, spikes, and a recruitment poster for roadkill. It does not stop for pedestrians.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Construct immunities (poison, charm, fatigue). Replace greatclub with spiked ram (same damage, bludgeoning+piercing). Trample: move through hostile spaces, Dex save DC 12 or take ram damage once per turn.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping. Canon win is clever explosives (munitions cart), not a fair duel.
entries.flavor: Clan boss who expects a duel and deserves a munitions accident. Cleverness is the real DPS.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Keep Hobgoblin Captain chassis. Reward cart-of-explosives plans: environmental kill should be possible without a full HP slog.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (confidence WIKI-ONLY on lore row; still on canon-floor-1). Lava spit = fire damage.
entries.flavor: Horse-sized, meth-adjacent, lava-spitting livestock. Aim for the throat pouch like you mean it.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Replace charge gore once per short rest with a spit: ranged 30 ft, +4 to hit, 2d6 fire. Weak-point: critical hits or aimed shots to the pouch (called shot / vulnerable) deal max weapon die once per round.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: wall-running kamikaze ravioli.
entries.flavor: Pasta-shaped suicide with legs. Climbs walls, latches on, makes a point.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Climb speed 30 ft. On death while attached: 1d6 acid splash to the host (house death burst).

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (SRD Troglodyte).
entries.flavor: Gym bro lizard with a weight-room smell. Hits like a kettlebell with daddy issues.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Keep stench; clubs/weights as melee.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping + reach poison tongue.
entries.flavor: Tiny conductor energy, whip tongue, poison encore. Reach is rude.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Add 10-ft tongue attack: +4, 1d4 piercing + DC 11 Con or poisoned until end of next turn. Slightly lower HP (−4) to pay for it.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: tiny leaping biter on Giant Rat chassis.
entries.flavor: Pocket lizard. Leaps, bites, ruins personal space.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Describe as Tiny troglodyte; jump 20 ft as part of move without long-jump check once per turn.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping. Burning free weights; veins are the tell.
entries.flavor: Steroid lizard who benches flaming plates. Hit the veins before he hits your resume.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Replace javelin with flaming plate: ranged 30/60, +6, 2d6 bludgeoning + 1d6 fire. Called shots to strained veins: once per round a hit can impose disadvantage on his next attack (house). Arena doors seal; red lights; support trogs poison/tie up.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping for the fused rolling formation; pop it to spill Tusklings.
entries.flavor: A rolling HOA of pig aristocrats. One attack pattern: become traffic.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Single HP pool (Ogre). Move + slam as trample (Dex DC 13, 2d8 bludgeoning). At 0 HP, splits into remaining Tusklings (see below) instead of dying clean.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: weak tuxedo pig once the ball pops.
entries.flavor: Tuxedo, tusks, no weapons, all entitlement. Catastrophic only in bulk.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Drop charge if you want them pathetic post-ball; keep gore.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping; slightly tougher than Knight.
entries.flavor: Gowned pig politics. Slightly more HP, same bad attitude.
entries.reskin_tweaks: +5 HP over Knight.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping; last pig standing / formation leader.
entries.flavor: Last Tuskling with a management title. Still a pig in boots.
entries.reskin_tweaks: +10 HP; pack leader: allies within 10 ft get +1 to attack while she lives.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping.
entries.flavor: White goat, fang mouth, winter branding. Bites like a blizzard with hooves.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Bite instead of horns if you want fangs; same damage, piercing.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: raccoon-headed spear goblin-tier.
entries.flavor: Raccoon face, spear, goblin pay grade. Trash-panda union enforcer.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Spear stats; otherwise Goblin Warrior.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (acidic cloth-dissolving blob).
entries.flavor: Laundry day from hell. Dissolves cloth, skin, and optimism.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Emphasize acid; corrodes nonmagical armor on hit as Gray Ooze.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: pod-burst plant that swallows ≈ constrictor.
entries.flavor: Thorny plant that leaps from pods and tries to wear you as fertilizer.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Plant type; describe constriction as vine wrap. Optional: emerge from a pod as surprise.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (seen early; thin detail).
entries.flavor: Wolf that lost an argument with a cactus. The spines are not decorative.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Melee attackers who hit it take 1d4 piercing (house spines).

entries.mapping_note: House mapping.
entries.flavor: Shapeless flaming mood. Hugs are a war crime.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Keep Magmin ignition; drop death burst intensity if packs feel mean.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping + Magic Missile eye-stalks.
entries.flavor: Hover-ray with eye-stalks that file Magic Missiles like expense reports.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Fly speed; once per turn cast magic missile at 1st level (force) instead of bite when it can see a target.

entries.flavor: Neighborhood boss that looks like a hovering crystal. The ledger has the nameplate, not the fight.
entries.mapping_note: No fight description captured — do not invent attacks for print beyond a placeholder.

entries.flavor: Promoted by patch, still waiting on a sermon script. Nameplate yes, choreography no.
entries.mapping_note: Patched upward in tier; no fight description in canon-floor-1.

entries.flavor: Collective mob the System yanked after a mass kill. Rumor fuel, not a fair fight.
entries.mapping_note: Do not field on Floor 1. Historical/patch note only.
House mapping: fuzzy corpse-eating worm.
entries.flavor: Cat-sized janitor worm. Eats corpses, squeaks, bursts into goo, tips the alchemist.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Remove centipede poison or keep mild; death: harmless goo + optional hemolymph reagent drop.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (WIKI-ONLY row; pre-pupa form).
entries.flavor: Final soft form before the sac. Whip tails for show, teeth for payroll.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Cosmetic tails; no web needed.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (Ochre Jelly sac). Caleb 2026-10-05 closes X-060.
entries.flavor: Human-sized wet timer with party lights. Wait it out and meet Vespas. Pop it early and meet unfinished nightmares.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Immobile; HP as Ochre Jelly. Timer end: release Brindled Vespas. Early destroy by Crawlers: convulsing half-formed creatures spill out (not Vespas).

entries.mapping_note: House mapping; population halved by patch.
entries.flavor: Hornet graduation ceremony. Acid spit included. Population was cut and they are still rude.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Swap poison sting damage type to acid (same dice) or add 1d4 acid on hit.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (WIKI-ONLY confidence). Contact Taint.
entries.flavor: Runny-nosed fairy cousin in green overalls. Slingshot, grapple, and a five-minute healing ban called the Taint.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Speed 40 ft. On melee hit or start grappling: target cannot regain HP for 5 minutes (Taint). Corpses ooze; touching them refreshes Taint.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: crow-sized winged soccer-mom fairy.
entries.flavor: Leaf pantsuit, Magic Missile, MLM brainworms. Believes Floor 3 is a promotion.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Replace shortbow with magic missile (1st level) 2/day. Resistance to necrotic/"health-seeping" if you track Taint-style drains.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (Chuul). Caleb 2026-10-05: Neighborhood Boss (closes X-059).
entries.flavor: Immobile octopus with screaming mouth-tentacles, snot, and measles mist. Nameplate insists it is a copy. At least three exist. Neighborhood Boss at this table.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Mostly stationary. Multiattack tentacles; on hit apply Taint. Aura/mist: Con save or catch Vigorous Measles (house disease: fever + disadvantage on checks until cured). Bursts through walls to start.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (WIKI-ONLY). Pet biscuit can flip hostility in the pound.
entries.flavor: Mastiff-sized, corpse-paint face, kobold optional. Feed the caged ones a biscuit and rewrite the fight.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Caged dingoes: indifferent after a Pet Biscuit (M-410). Ridden dingoes act on kobold rider initiative.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping; lance charge while mounted.
entries.flavor: Yappy chihuahua energy on a painted wolf. Feathered lance, zero impulse control.
entries.reskin_tweaks: While mounted on a Danger Dingo, lance deals 1d12 once per charge (house); on foot use Kobold stats.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping (WIKI-ONLY). Cute until the jaw unhinges; survives being swallowed.
entries.flavor: Champion pit gerbil. Adorable. Mouth opens like a luggage fault. Being eaten is a commute.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Bite; if swallowed by a dingo/ally beast, reappears from inside after 1 round at half HP instead of dying (house).

entries.mapping_note: House mapping: floating jam-filled brain; psychic headache scales with low Int.
entries.flavor: Slow kickball full of thoughts you did not order. High Intelligence shrugs; everyone else gets a migraine with teeth.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Replace life drain with psychic: DC 12 Int save or 2d6 psychic and speed −10 ft until end of next turn. Creatures with Int 16+ auto-succeed. Fly/hover; low physical damage.

entries.flavor: Warehouse blimp boss the Meadow Lark crew sniped before it left the garage. Wood later became a float frame.
entries.mapping_note: No attack, AI text, or chamber write-up (backlog rb-03). Do not invent a full kit for Core print yet.

entries.flavor: Armor-piercing quills with a cute name. Seeded, then patched to a deeper floor.
entries.mapping_note: Do not field on Floor 2 after the relocation announcement (~4 d 17 h before collapse).

entries.source_row: mob2-impaler → relocated F3 by house ruling
entries.flavor: Mordecai's "everywhere" headache, finally given a street address on Floor 3. Acid darts, bad hair, worse reviews.
entries.mapping_note: House mapping. Canon is a Mordecai warning with no confirmed F2 sighting; Caleb places it on Floor 3 as CANON-RUMOR.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Hairy green four-legs. Replace bite once per turn with acid spit: ranged 30/60, +4 to hit, 2d6 acid. Climb 20 ft.

entries.mapping_note: House mapping for the bathroom-penalty smoke horror. Summoned, not a random wanderer.
entries.flavor: Fifteen feet of black-purple smoke, obsidian claws, horned skull. Arrows are opinions. Peeing outside is how you cast it.
entries.reskin_tweaks: Resistance to nonmagical weapons emphasized. Fire damage slows regeneration (house: no regen on any turn it took fire). Once per fight: reverse gravity in a 30-ft cylinder for 1 round (Str save DC 15). Lure into stairwell holes works.

entries.flavor: Named on the roster. Personality: TBD by whoever survives meeting one.
entries.mapping_note: Name only in ledger. Tentative unused map: Giant Eagle or Warhorse if you must run it.

entries.flavor: Drifting eyeballs from the cold open montage. Creepy wallpaper with agency.
entries.mapping_note: No combat kit captured. Optional unused map: Flumph or Specter without drain.

entries.flavor: Later-recap cameo. Three heads, one bad decision tree.
entries.mapping_note: No kit. Optional unused map: Ape with Multiattack ×3 at reduced damage.

entries.flavor: Produce aisle horror. Chewable metaphor for the tutorial.
entries.mapping_note: No kit. Optional unused map: Awakened Shrub with a bite.

entries.reskin_tweaks: Climb 30 ft. Latch as Stirge blood drain, but on death while attached: 1d6 acid (hemolymph) to the host. Soft grub body; Floor 2 janitor-adjacent.
entries.mapping_note: HOUSE. Fills the cheap swarming-exploder slot Rot Stickers wrongly listed on F2 (X-080 / M-765). Not canon.
entries.flavor: Thumb-sized soft grubs that mistake Crawlers for corpses. They latch, fizz, and pop into hot hemolymph. Floor 2's answer to ravioli terrorism — without stealing Floor 1's Rot Stickers.
